items.title: Tyson Foods to shut down Illinois beef facility, leaving 2,500 jobless: officials
items.summary: Meat processor Tyson Foods announced this week that it will shut down a beef facility just east of the Quad Cities as part of a larger national restructuring of its beef operations, a sweeping change that local elected officials say would lay off some 2,500 workers in Illinois alone.
